tagline: Compassionate counselling for steadier days and meaningful change.
description: Individual counselling in Vancouver, BC with Amanda Hecimovic, RCC — support for anxiety, mood, relationships, stress, and life transitions.
hours: Monday to Thursday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM

insuranceNotes: Receipts can be provided for reimbursement through extended health benefits.
Coverage varies by plan, provider type, and province. Clients are encouraged to confirm details with their insurer before booking.
A limited number of sliding scale spaces may be available. Ask about availability during consultation.

externalLink.label: Book an appointment online
externalLink.description: Appointments are scheduled through Jane App. You will leave this site to choose a time and complete your booking.

bookSession.label: Book a Session
bookSession.title: Request a counselling session
bookSession.description: Are you an existing client? Send a session request here, or contact me by email or phone. I will follow up to confirm scheduling. If you are new to the practice, please start with a consultation.
bookSession.descriptionWithCalendar: Choose a session type and an available time from the calendar, then send your request.
bookSession.confirmationMessage: Your session request has been received. The appointment is not confirmed until the practice follows up.

consultationCopy.title: Start with a brief consultation
consultationCopy.description: A short conversation to ask questions, share what you are looking for, and decide whether counselling feels like a good fit.

bookSession.consultationSuccessMessage: Thank you for reaching out. I will reply within the stated response time to confirm next steps.

calendar.availabilityHelpText: Available times are based on the public calendar and include a short buffer between sessions.

sessionTypes.label: Brief consultation
sessionTypes.description: A brief call to ask questions, share what you are looking for, and decide on next steps.

sessionTypes.label: Individual counselling
sessionTypes.description: One-to-one support for anxiety, mood, stress, grief, identity, and life transitions.

sessionTypes.label: Extended session
sessionTypes.description: Additional time for deeper work, complex concerns, or treatment planning.

contactForm.disclaimer: Please do not put sensitive information in the message field. I will follow up with you via email or phone. If you are in a crisis, or need immediate assistance, please call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room.
contactForm.successMessage: Thanks for reaching out. I will follow up by email or phone within the stated response time.
